/-!
# Capsules and processions (taxis #43)

Combinatorial backbone of the **large volume container** of the Corollary 3.12 variant
(taxis #33): capsules of labels and processions of capsules, together with the standard
label sets `S_{j+1} = {0, 1, …, j}` of the procession of tensor-packets of log-shells.

## Source correspondence

* Capsules and processions of label sets: IUT I, §§4–6 (in particular the processions of
  ±-label capsules of IUT I, Proposition 6.9).
* The label sets `S_{j+1}` and the procession whose `j`-th capsule has label set
  `S_{j+1}` (`j = 1, …, ℓ*`): IUT III, Propositions 3.1–3.3; Hoshi, *Introduction to
  inter-universal Teichmüller theory (continued)*, §13.

This module records only the combinatorics: the tensor-packets themselves are built on
top of these labels in `Iut.Cor312.Container`. Nothing here asserts any statement of the
IUT papers; the definitions are plain finite combinatorics.

## Main definitions

* `Iut.procLabels j`: the label set `S_{j+1} = {0, …, j}` as a `Finset ℕ`.
* `Iut.Capsule`: a capsule of labels, i.e. a finite set of labels.
* `Iut.Procession`: an increasing chain of capsules together with its inclusion maps.
* `Iut.Procession.standard n`: the standard procession `S_2 ⊆ S_3 ⊆ ⋯ ⊆ S_{n+1}` of the
  tensor-packet construction, with `n = ℓ* = (ℓ - 1)/2` in the intended instantiation.
-/

namespace Iut

/-- The label set `S_{j+1} = {0, 1, …, j}` of IUT III, Propositions 3.1–3.3, a finite
set of `j + 1` labels. The index convention follows the papers: the *subscript* of `S`
is the cardinality, so `procLabels j` is the set called `S_{j+1}`. -/
def procLabels (j : ℕ) : Finset ℕ := Finset.Iic j

lemma procLabels_mono {i j : ℕ} (h : i ≤ j) : procLabels i ⊆ procLabels j :=
  Finset.Iic_subset_Iic.mpr h

/-- A **capsule** of labels drawn from `ι`: a finite collection of labels
(IUT I, §4). The objects indexed by a capsule (prime strips, log-shells, …) are
attached on top of this combinatorial datum by the container modules. -/
structure Capsule (ι : Type*) where
  /-- The finite set of labels of the capsule. -/
  labels : Finset ι

namespace Capsule

variable {ι : Type*}

/-- The number of labels of a capsule. -/
def card (S : Capsule ι) : ℕ := S.labels.card

/-- The label set of a capsule, as a type. -/
def LabelType (S : Capsule ι) : Type _ := S.labels

instance [DecidableEq ι] (S : Capsule ι) : DecidableEq S.LabelType :=
  inferInstanceAs (DecidableEq S.labels)

instance (S : Capsule ι) : Fintype S.LabelType :=
  inferInstanceAs (Fintype S.labels)

end Capsule

/-- A **procession** of capsules (IUT I, §§4–6): a finite increasing chain of capsules.
The inclusion maps of the chain are recorded by `labels_mono`; see
`Procession.inclusion` for the induced maps of label types. -/
structure Procession (ι : Type*) where
  /-- The number of capsules in the procession. -/
  length : ℕ
  /-- The capsules of the procession. -/
  capsule : Fin length → Capsule ι
  /-- Monotonicity: the labels of the capsules form an increasing chain. This datum
  encodes the inclusion maps of the procession. -/
  labels_mono : ∀ ⦃i j : Fin length⦄, i ≤ j → (capsule i).labels ⊆ (capsule j).labels

namespace Procession

variable {ι : Type*} (P : Procession ι)

/-- The **standard procession** of the tensor-packet construction: the chain
`S_2 ⊆ S_3 ⊆ ⋯ ⊆ S_{n+1}` of label sets, where the `i`-th capsule (`i = 0, …, n-1`,
corresponding to the paper's index `j = i + 1 ∈ {1, …, ℓ*}`) has label set
`S_{j+1} = {0, 1, …, j}`. In the intended instantiation `n = ℓ* = (ℓ - 1)/2` for the
prime `ℓ` of the initial Θ-data (IUT III, Propositions 3.1–3.3). -/
def standard (n : ℕ) : Procession ℕ where
  length := n
  capsule i := ⟨procLabels (i + 1)⟩
  labels_mono i j h := procLabels_mono (by exact Nat.add_le_add_right h 1)

end Procession

end Iut

end AbcAdaptation.Reference
payload.natural_language_statement:
**Formal-code readback**

**English**

All declarations are in the namespace AbcAdaptation.Reference.Iut. The natural numbers include zero. For every natural number j, procLabels(j) is the finite set {m ∈ ℕ | m ≤ j}, namely {0, …, j}. The lemma procLabels_mono states that, for every pair of natural numbers i and j, the assumption i ≤ j implies procLabels(i) ⊆ procLabels(j).

For an arbitrary type ι, Capsule ι is finite label-set data consisting of one field, labels : Finset ι. No finiteness, nonemptiness, ordering, or decidable equality is assumed for the ambient type ι. For every S : Capsule ι, Capsule.card(S) : ℕ is the cardinality of S.labels. Capsule.LabelType(S) is the subtype {x : ι // x ∈ S.labels}; its elements are labels together with proofs of membership, rather than all elements of ι. The code provides an instance of decidable equality on this subtype when ι has decidable equality. It also provides a Fintype instance on this subtype for every S, with no decidable-equality hypothesis on ι for that instance. An empty labels field is allowed; then card(S) = 0 and LabelType(S) is empty. No nonempty-label condition is imposed on a general Capsule.

For an arbitrary type ι, Procession ι consists of a natural number length, a function capsule : Fin length → Capsule ι, and a proof labels_mono. Here Fin length is the type of natural indices i with 0 ≤ i < length, with the usual order. The proof requires, for every i, j : Fin length, that i ≤ j imply (capsule i).labels ⊆ (capsule j).labels. This is a finite sequence of finite label sets in the same ambient type, increasing in the non-strict sense of inclusion. Equal sets at different indices and empty label sets are permitted. There is no requirement of strict growth, prescribed cardinality, or coverage of the ambient type. The length may be zero, in which case the index type is empty and the monotonicity condition is vacuous.

For every n : ℕ, Procession.standard(n) : Procession ℕ is the specified sequence of length n. At index i : Fin n, its finite label set is procLabels(↑i + 1) = {m : ℕ | m ≤ ↑i + 1}, where ↑i is the underlying natural number. The monotonicity field is supplied using procLabels_mono and preservation of ≤ under addition of 1. This definition has no parameter P : Procession ι; the namespace variable P is unused in its definition. When n = 0 the sequence has no entries. When n > 0 its first label set is {0, 1}; the set at index i has ↑i + 2 elements, and its last set is {0, …, n}. Thus the definition does not begin with {0}. These descriptions concern the actual finite-set construction and carry no additional interpretation of its identifiers.

**简体中文**

本项目按用户约定将 Capsule 称为“标签集”，将 Procession 称为“标签集递增族”。此处的标签集有限，族的递增关系允许相等。

所有声明均位于命名空间 AbcAdaptation.Reference.Iut 中。自然数包含零。对每个自然数 j，procLabels(j) 是有限集 {m ∈ ℕ | m ≤ j}，即 {0, …, j}。引理 procLabels_mono 断言：对任意自然数 i、j，若 i ≤ j，则 procLabels(i) ⊆ procLabels(j)。

对任意类型 ι，Capsule ι 是有限标签集数据，仅含一个字段 labels : Finset ι。不要求整个类型 ι 有限、非空、有序或具有可判定的相等关系。对每个 S : Capsule ι，Capsule.card(S) : ℕ 是有限集 S.labels 的基数。Capsule.LabelType(S) 是子类型 {x : ι // x ∈ S.labels}；其元素由标签及其属于该有限集的证明组成，而不是 ι 中的所有元素。若 ι 上的相等关系可判定，代码便为该子类型提供可判定的相等关系实例。此外，对每个 S，代码都为该子类型提供有限类型实例；这个实例不要求 ι 上的相等关系可判定。允许 labels 为空，此时 card(S) = 0，LabelType(S) 为空类型。一般的 Capsule 不要求标签集非空。

对任意类型 ι，Procession ι 由自然数 length、函数 capsule : Fin length → Capsule ι 以及证明 labels_mono 组成。其中，Fin length 是满足 0 ≤ i < length 的自然数指标构成的类型，采用通常的次序。证明字段要求：对任意 i、j : Fin length，若 i ≤ j，则 (capsule i).labels ⊆ (capsule j).labels。因此，这是一列取自同一类型的递增有限标签集，递增指非严格的包含关系。不同位置的标签集可以相等，标签集也可以为空。不要求严格增长、指定基数或覆盖整个类型。length 可以为零；此时指标类型为空，单调性条件自然成立。

对每个 n : ℕ，Procession.standard(n) : Procession ℕ 是长度为 n 的指定序列。在指标 i : Fin n 处，其有限标签集为 procLabels(↑i + 1) = {m : ℕ | m ≤ ↑i + 1}，其中 ↑i 表示 i 对应的自然数。单调性字段使用 procLabels_mono 以及加上 1 保持非严格不等式的性质构造。该定义不含参数 P : Procession ι；命名空间内声明的变量 P 没有在该定义中使用。n = 0 时，序列没有任何项。n > 0 时，第一项的标签集是 {0, 1}；指标 i 处的标签集含 ↑i + 2 个元素，最后一项是 {0, …, n}。因此，该构造的第一项不是 {0}。这些说明仅解释实际的有限集构造，不为其标识符添加额外含义。

**日本語**

すべての宣言は名前空間 AbcAdaptation.Reference.Iut に属する。自然数には零を含む。各自然数 j に対し、procLabels(j) は有限集合 {m ∈ ℕ | m ≤ j}、すなわち {0, …, j} である。補題 procLabels_mono は、任意の自然数 i、j について、i ≤ j ならば procLabels(i) ⊆ procLabels(j) であることを述べる。

任意の型 ι に対し、Capsule ι は有限なラベル集合のデータであり、唯一のフィールド labels : Finset ι を持つ。型 ι 全体が有限、非空、順序付きであることも、その等号が決定可能であることも仮定しない。各 S : Capsule ι に対し、Capsule.card(S) : ℕ は S.labels の要素数である。Capsule.LabelType(S) は部分型 {x : ι // x ∈ S.labels} であり、その要素はラベルと所属の証明からなる。ι のすべての要素を表す型ではない。ι の等号が決定可能である場合、この部分型にも等号の決定可能性のインスタンスが与えられる。また、各 S について、この部分型の有限型インスタンスが与えられる。この有限型インスタンスには ι の等号の決定可能性を仮定しない。labels は空でもよく、その場合 card(S) = 0 で、LabelType(S) は空の型である。一般の Capsule にラベル集合の非空性は要求されない。

任意の型 ι に対し、Procession ι は自然数 length、関数 capsule : Fin length → Capsule ι、および証明 labels_mono からなる。Fin length は 0 ≤ i < length を満たす自然数の添字の型であり、通常の順序を持つ。証明フィールドは、任意の i、j : Fin length について、i ≤ j ならば (capsule i).labels ⊆ (capsule j).labels であることを要求する。したがって、同一の型に属する有限なラベル集合の有限列であり、包含関係について広義単調増加する。異なる位置で集合が等しくてもよく、ラベル集合が空でもよい。真の包含による増大、指定された要素数、型全体の被覆は要求されない。length は零でもよく、その場合は添字の型が空で、単調性条件は空虚に成り立つ。

各 n : ℕ に対し、Procession.standard(n) : Procession ℕ は長さ n の指定された列である。添字 i : Fin n における有限なラベル集合は procLabels(↑i + 1) = {m : ℕ | m ≤ ↑i + 1} であり、↑i は i の基となる自然数を表す。単調性のフィールドは procLabels_mono と、両辺に 1 を加える操作が ≤ を保つことによって与えられる。この定義は P : Procession ι を引数に持たず、名前空間で宣言された変数 P は定義に使われていない。n = 0 の場合、列に項はない。n > 0 の場合、最初のラベル集合は {0, 1} であり、添字 i の集合の要素数は ↑i + 2、最後の集合は {0, …, n} である。したがって、この構成は {0} から始まるものではない。以上は有限集合の構成自体の説明であり、識別子にそれ以外の意味を付与するものではない。

**Paper source context (English; separate from the formal-code readback)**

**Paper source context.** Mochizuki I, §0 (pp. 33–34), defines a capsule as a finite indexed family of objects of a category, and defines its morphisms using injections of index sets together with component morphisms. III, Introduction (p. 10), replaces a single label container by a diagram of inclusions of finite sets, referring to I, Propositions 4.11 and 6.9. The displayed sets are $\mathbb S^{\pm}_{j+1}=\{0,1,\ldots,j\}$, including $j=0$. The local combinatorial carrier retains only the finite label sets and their monotone inclusions.

**Implementation scope.** Capsule stores a finite subset of a fixed label type, with its cardinality and its label subtype. Procession stores a finite, non-strictly increasing chain of such finite subsets. This is a specialization to label bookkeeping, not the full paper capsule of objects and morphisms; it stores neither the attached objects nor their component morphisms. In standard(n), local index $i$ corresponds to paper label bound $j=i+1$, so the local chain starts with $\mathbb S^{\pm}_2$ and omits the paper’s initial singleton $\mathbb S^{\pm}_1$. The generic definitions allow empty label sets and length $0$.

Shinichi Mochizuki, *Inter-universal Teichmüller Theory I: Construction of Hodge Theaters* (May 2020), §0, Monoids and Categories, paragraph defining capsules (crosses the page break); printed/PDF page(s) 33, 34.

> Let $\mathcal C$ be a category. We define a capsule of objects of $\mathcal C$ to be a finite collection $\{A_j\}_{j\in J}$ [i.e., where $J$ is a finite index set] of objects $A_j$ of $\mathcal C$; if $|J|$ denotes the cardinality of $J$, then we shall refer to a capsule with index set $J$ as a $|J|$-capsule; also, we shall write $\pi_0(\{A_j\}_{j\in J})\overset{\mathrm{def}}{=}J$.

Transcription: visually checked; line breaks and typography are normalized as recorded in the source evidence.

Shinichi Mochizuki, *Inter-universal Teichmüller Theory I: Construction of Hodge Theaters* (May 2020), §0, immediately after the capsule definition, first morphism sentence and its consequence; printed/PDF page(s) 34.

> A morphism of capsules of objects of $\mathcal C$
>
> $$\{A_j\}_{j\in J}\to\{A'_{j'}\}_{j'\in J'}$$
>
> is defined to consist of an injection $\iota:J\hookrightarrow J'$, together with, for each $j\in J$, a morphism $A_j\to A'_{\iota(j)}$ of objects of $\mathcal C$. Thus, the capsules of objects of $\mathcal C$ form a category $\operatorname{Capsule}(\mathcal C)$.

Transcription: visually checked; line breaks and typography are normalized as recorded in the source evidence.

Shinichi Mochizuki, *Inter-universal Teichmüller Theory III: Canonical Splittings of the Log-theta-lattice* (May 2020), Introduction, sentence introducing the alternative approach via processions; printed/PDF page(s) 10.

> Thus, we consider the following alternative approach, via processions [cf. [IUTchI], Propositions, 4.11, 6.9].

Transcription: visually checked; line breaks and typography are normalized as recorded in the source evidence.

**Actual consumer.** Theorem110’s proof rewrites the supplied container chain to Procession.standard(X.lstar). It then uses capsule cardinalities in the normalized sum. The combinatorics organize the supplied local estimates and do not prove the paper’s symmetry, prime-strip, or Corollary 3.12 assertions.

These Definitions are detached source preparation; the consumer paths describe the original reference graph and do not establish live mission-root membership or S2-04 completion.
